title: Santy Anna
source: Traditional windlass and capstan shanty. Words and tune from Richard Runciman Terry, The Shanty Book, Part I (London: Curwen, 1921), No. 8 "Santy Anna" (all five stanzas; Terry d. 1938), where the tune is in F minor (M.M. 116); set here in A minor, harmony original. Terry cites the version in W. B. Whall, Sea Songs and Shanties (1910), "The Plains of Mexico", whose stanzas 1 and 5 match. The later "Santiana" verses ("Molly-del-Rey", "heave her up") are not used.
attribution: Santy Anna - Traditional (sea shanty), after R. R. Terry, The Shanty Book (1921). Arrangement by Self-Guitar contributors, released under CC0.
